description: The Metal Dragon in Chinese astrology: personality, Metal element traits, 1940 and 2000 dates and compatibility.
answer: In Chinese astrology, the Metal Dragon is the Dragon born in a Metal year, one of five versions of the fifth animal. It combines the Dragon's vitality with Metal's qualities. Metal Dragon years between 1924 and 2044 are 1940 and 2000. The Dragon's fixed element is Earth.

sections.heading: The Metal Dragon personality
paragraphs: In the five-element cycle, Earth generates Metal, and the Dragon's fixed element is Earth, so a Metal year draws on the Dragon's substance to forge something hard and bright. Metal Dragons are often described as strong-willed, principled and intensely driven, with a clear sense of right and wrong. They tend to be decisive, articulate and fearless in defending their convictions, and they can achieve a great deal through sheer determination. Readings frequently mention integrity as a defining trait. That same determination may also make them inflexible and demanding. Because so much energy flows outwards into Metal's purpose, Metal Dragons can neglect their own needs and struggle to accept help, advice or compromise.

Metal is the element of autumn and harvest, and a Metal year is traditionally said to sharpen whatever animal it meets. Descriptions associate it with determination, discipline, clear judgement and a strong code of principle. Metal-year people are often portrayed as decisive, self-reliant and willing to do difficult things because they are right. The element is linked with refinement and with cutting away what is unnecessary, so it tends to bring focus and high standards. Its traditional shadow is rigidity: Metal can become inflexible, proud or emotionally guarded, preferring to be correct over being close, and finding it hard to bend once a position is taken.

sections.heading: Metal Dragon at work and in love
paragraphs: At work, Metal is usually linked with discipline, precision and principled leadership. Metal-year people are often described as the ones who set standards, cut through confusion and finish what they start, which suits law, engineering, finance, surgery, editing and any role that values exactness. They tend to work well alone and lead by example. The traditional caution is inflexibility: a Metal stem can dismiss ideas that arrive untidily, so practising curiosity before judgement usually makes them better leaders.

An iron will drives the Metal Dragon towards its goals, and tradition describes a formidable professional. Law, finance, elite sport, military command and turnaround consulting are typical associations, each prizing decisiveness and incorruptible standards. It works best given a clear mandate and full ownership of results, and shared credit can rankle. Even rivals tend to respect its honesty. In love the Metal Dragon is loyal, principled and fiercely protective of anyone it calls its own. A partner of strong character who can meet its intensity without flinching suits it best. The friction most often mentioned is inflexibility: once convinced, it rarely softens, and loved ones may feel measured against an impossible ideal.

sections.heading: Metal Dragon years and dates
paragraphs: Metal Dragon years in the Lunar New Year table run from February 8, 1940 to January 26, 1941 and from February 5, 2000 to January 23, 2001. Because the year begins at Lunar New Year, a birthday in January or early February needs checking: in 1940 anyone born before Feb 8 is a Earth Rabbit, not a Metal Dragon. Sixty years separate each Metal Dragon year, the length of a full round of five elements and twelve animals. Every Metal Dragon year is Yang, matching the Dragon's own polarity.

Its traditional name is Geng-Chen: Geng is the yang Metal stem and Chen is the Dragon's branch. Births just before each new year fall in the Earth Rabbit year (before February 8, 1940) and the Earth Rabbit year (before February 5, 2000), and births in the weeks after each Metal Dragon year ends belong to the Metal Snake. The new year itself fell on a Thursday in 1940 and Saturday in 2000.

sections.heading: Growth edges and compatibility for the Metal Dragon
paragraphs: Metal Dragons often grow most by distinguishing principle from preference. Not every disagreement involves a matter of integrity, and recognising which ones do saves a great deal of friction. They may also benefit from regular reflection on their goals, ensuring that relentless drive still points somewhere meaningful. Accepting help, even when they could manage alone, strengthens relationships. Physical activities that combine discipline and calm, such as martial arts, swimming or yoga, suit their temperament. When conviction is softened by curiosity about others, the Metal Dragon becomes a principled, admired and effective leader.

For relationships, the classical structures belong to the animal rather than the element, so the Metal Dragon shares the Dragon's San He trine with the Rat and Monkey (the Water trine), its Liu He bond with the Rooster, and its Liu Chong clash with the Dog. The element adds a second layer: another Metal sign shares this year element, while partners whose year element feeds Metal in the generating cycle are often described as supportive.

faq.question: What years are Metal Dragon years?
faq.answer: Between 1924 and 2044: 1940 (from February 8, 1940) and 2000 (from February 5, 2000). Each lasts until the day before the next Lunar New Year.

faq.question: What is the Metal Dragon's element relationship?
faq.answer: The year element is Metal and the Dragon's fixed element is Earth; in the five-element cycles earth generates Metal. Readings use that relationship to describe how easily the two sides of the sign sit together.

faq.question: Which animals are most compatible with the Metal Dragon?
faq.answer: Traditionally the Rat and Monkey (San He) and the Rooster (Liu He). The Dog is the Liu Chong clash. These pairings depend on the animal, whatever the element.

faq.question: What is the Metal Dragon called in the Chinese calendar?
faq.answer: Geng-Chen. In almanacs and Four Pillars charts each year is named by its heavenly stem, here the Metal stem Geng, followed by its earthly branch, here Chen for the Dragon, so the name pins down both halves of the combination at once.

faq.question: How is the Metal Dragon different from other Dragons?
faq.answer: All Dragons share vitality, ambition and confidence. The Metal year element changes the tone: metal is the element of autumn and harvest, and a Metal year is traditionally said to sharpen whatever animal it meets.
